records.title: Rounded portrait — メ, ノノ and ｲ in neighboring rows
records.observed_visual: Row 1 places メ on the upper hair contour; row 2 has ノノ; row 8 has ｲ on the left hair/face side. Inspect the neighboring rows and intact strokes, not isolated character meanings.
records.drawn_analogy: A rounded head/hair construction. 彡 and 州 occur in the hair mass; neither is identified as the operator's forgotten kanji.
records.review: Luna and parent inspected paired native PNG/TXT; source observation, not operator art approval.

records.title: Watermelon — punctuation rim and striped lower return
records.observed_visual: Punctuation traces much of the round outer rim. Row 20 places ﾒﾌ where a stripe reaches the lower rim. ｲ and 州/洲 participate in interior stripe constructions; stripes are not interchangeable with the outer contour.
records.drawn_analogy: Round fruit with corresponding rim, stripe entries and intentional paper. This does not identify the operator's forgotten kanji.
records.review: Parent inspected paired native PNG/TXT; source observation, not operator art approval.

records.title: Circular ring — shallow arcs, diagonals and vertical sides
records.observed_visual: Eight rows construct the ring with shallow top/bottom marks, diagonals, vertical sides, a small cap and open paper. The changing contour is not spelled by repeating one fixed-slope glyph.
records.drawn_analogy: Circular ring construction, not a glyph-to-circle dictionary or motion demonstration.
records.review: Parent inspected paired native PNG/TXT; source observation, not operator art approval.

records.title: Tomato-section fruit — open rounded body and raised stem
records.observed_visual: Rows 1–15 build a broad rounded body: raised stem/calyx at 1–3, shoulders at 4–7, sides at 8–12 and curved bottom at 13–15. Punctuation, slashes and horizontal/vertical strokes preserve a largely open interior.
records.drawn_analogy: Rounded fruit; tomato-section item per the archive's preceding heading, not a claim of artist intent.
records.review: Luna inspected paired native PNG/TXT; source observation, not operator art approval.

records.title: Bicycle — sparse wheel rims connected to the frame
records.observed_visual: Rows 7–20 contain two rounded wheel rims built with punctuation bands, sloped returns and sparse interior marks. Frame tubes connect the hubs; the circular read belongs to the multi-row assembly, not just isolated dots.
records.drawn_analogy: Two wheel constructions, not evidence that any particular kana sequence means circle. No original live URL was established from the inspected manifest.
records.review: Luna inspected paired native PNG/TXT; source observation, not operator art approval.

records.title: Figure and halo — enclosing tapered oval and internal motif
records.observed_visual: Rows 1–30 construct a tapered oval/teardrop enclosure around a seated figure; 31–35 form the pedestal. Parentheses, slashes and kana-like strokes articulate the contour. Repeated 非 is an internal halo motif, not its perimeter.
records.drawn_analogy: Enclosing oval with an interior figure and motif. 非 is not identified as the operator's forgotten kanji.
records.review: Luna inspected paired native PNG/TXT; source observation, not operator art approval.

records.title: Veiled figure — nested head, veil and shoulder arcs
records.observed_visual: Rows 2–24 show the rounded head nested inside the larger veil/shoulder envelope. Row 2 has イ at the upper turn; lower rows widen into shoulders. Punctuation bands are interior veil cues, not the outer contour.
records.drawn_analogy: Nested rounded boundaries; this packaged archive pair is distinct from the separately annotated S#424 artifact record.
records.review: Luna inspected paired native PNG/TXT; source observation, not additional operator art approval.
